title: Budget
summary: Eat well for less: pap, beans, eggs, pilchards, oats and seasonal veg.
description: Healthy eating does not have to cost much. This plan sticks to affordable staples you can buy at any spaza or supermarket: maize meal, oats, brown bread, dried or tinned beans and lentils, eggs, pilchards, chicken pieces, cabbage, carrots, bananas and apples. Cook once, eat twice: many of these meals keep well for the next day.
highlights: Tinned fish and beans for cheap protein
